name: repo-hygiene
description: Keep any repo's agent-facing layer healthy — version-manager (standardized version bumps + changelogs, auto-detects where the version lives), repo-doctor (audit of AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md topology, CodeMap freshness, token cost, doc drift), claude-md-optimizer (rightsize CLAUDE.md per Anthropic context-engineering guidance), unify-agents-md (make AGENTS.md the single canonical guide every coding CLI follows), and land-pr (finish pull requests: classify every open PR, cut the version bump at merge time, merge, tag the merge commit, close superseded autofix drafts).
